links.text: "Tell me more about the scepter of judgement."

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30868-05.ht.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Please find Cleo and ask her advice on the Scepter of Judgment. East of the village you will find a bridge. Cross it and you will find her.

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30868-06.ht.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: An Imperial grave? A grave keeper? Guardian of a key? Traveling freely through time and space? Must be pierced with two-pronged lance? I've got a pretty good idea what they mean...

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-0a.htm.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: The townsfolk of Aden Castle live in mortal fear of the Raid Bosses in this area. If they were to actually make it into the village... I must find a Clan Leader who leads a very powerful Clan. Can you recommend anyone? (Only Clan Leaders of Clans of level 5 and above may undertake…

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-0b.htm.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: It hasn't been long since I saw you, but your Clan has certainly grown! Would you and your Clan be interested in raising your reputation ? We could really use some help here!

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-8.html.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Now that you are no longer a clan lord, I have nothing to ask of you. Go in peace.

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-0.html.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Thank you! There are several Raid Bosses near the village. Which one can you defeat? Remember, you don't have to kill the Raid Boss by yourself. There is no rule that says the clan leader has to use his sword. If your clan members defeat the Raid Boss, simply bring back proof of y…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30868-03.ht.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: As you may know, it is said that the scepter makes its possessor invincible in battle. Although this is probably just a legend, having it will greatly boost our soldiers' morale. However, we are losing hope of finding it. We hired Dwarven Bounty Hunters to find it and they have ha…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30868-04.ht.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: It is impossible to guess how old these three women are. They typically show up, mumble some incomprehensible incantations and vanish. My father has become obsessed by their remarks. I'm not sure if these witches have been of any help to my family in the past. If it was up to me I…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30868-06a.h.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Let me see if I can put them together... It is at the National Cemetery... Once you defeat the grave keeper a key master will show up and give you a key... When you collect all six keys, you must overpower the imperial grave keeper and find the scepter... You must take care, as th…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30868-10.ht.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Sir Gustav Athebaldt is an uncle of King Amadeo Cadmus. He is next in succession to the royal throne. He feigns a disinterest in politics to dispel people's suspicions, while in reality he controls many cliques which are undermining the power of the king. He ulimately plans to sei…

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-0c.htm.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: The townsfolk of Aden Castle live in mortal fear of the Raid Bosses in this area. If they were to actually make it into the village... Naturally, we have guards posted, but there aren't any guarantees! Please, use the power of your Clan to set the townsfolk free from fear! Help us…

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-1.html.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Very good! Slaughter Palibati Queen Themis and bring me her scale! As I told you before, you don't have to kill her yourself! Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-1a.html.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Very well! Slay Palibati Queen Themis and bring me her scale. Remember, you don't have to kill Palibati Queen Themis yourself. Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-1b.html.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Well done! I'll spread the news that your brave Clan has defeated Palibati Queen Themis.

links.text: "I want to continue killing Raid Bosses."

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-2.html.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Then kill Shillien Priest Hisilrome and bring me his heart. As I mentioned before, you don't have to kill Hisilrome yourself. There is no rule that says the clan leader has to use his sword personally. If your clan members defeat Hisilrome, simply bring back proof of the victory.

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-2a.html.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Kill Shillien Priest Hisilrome and bring me his heart. A word of advice: you don't have to kill Hisilrome yourself. There is no rule that says the clan leader has to use his sword personally. If your clan members defeat Hisilrome, simply bring back proof of the victory.

links.text: Quit this mission and take on a new one.

Q00508_AClansReputation/30868-2b.html.text: Sir Eric Rodemai: Well done! I'll tell everyone how bravely your clan defeated Shillien Priest Hisilrome.
